entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used by the UE to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the network.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates transmission of protocol configuration options to the network.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options not supported
entities.description: Condition where either the UE or the network does not support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: UE transmits the protocol configuration options IE when it wishes to send protocol data to the network.
Protocol configuration options IE is included when extended protocol configuration options are not supported by UE or network.
